violation_type.title: Substitutes, Volunteers and Contractors - Counted in Ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(d))
violation_type.short_title: Substitutes, Volunteers and Contractors - Counted in Ratio
violation_type.typical_finding: One contracted caregiver that is counted in ratio does not have documentated annual training hours for her last complete training year of 7/22/2019 to 7/22/2021.

finding_variants.text: One contracted caregiver that is counted in ratio does not have documentated annual training hours for her last complete training year of 7/22/2019 to 7/22/2021.

A volunteer who is frequently or regularly present at the operation and provides direct care to children does not comply with minimum standards that apply to employees and caregivers. The volunteer was observed in the infant room during the inspection.

The contracted caregiver counted in ratio received one hour of child abuse training in recognizing, reporting, and preventing abuse.     However annual training that is still lacking includes health and safety training in emergency preparedness; preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations; administering medication, if applicable, preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
